title: Spilling Some Tea on Writing as Communication and Art
summary: Kahran and Divya zoom across the many shapes writing can take — corporate communication, documentary, emotive expression, fantasy, comics, game narrative — and what each demands. They get especially deep into writing for choice-based games versus writing for prose, the player-as-protagonist problem, and how Kahran's MFA work has reframed his sense of craft.

intents.display: to think about writing as craft across games, comics and prose
